title: overlapping_part_rejected test comment: overlap is 11 bytes, not 10
description:
yencoding-multi/tests/integration.rs line 202 reads:

  // Part 2: bytes 49..99 (yEnc begin=50, end=100) — overlaps part 1 by 10 bytes

The actual overlap is 11 bytes, not 10.

Part 1: yEnc begin=1, end=60 → 0-based exclusive range [0..60) — bytes 0..=59
Part 2: yEnc begin=50, end=100 → 0-based exclusive range [49..100) — bytes 49..=99

Overlap = {49, 50, ..., 59} = 11 bytes (60 − 49 = 11).

The author computed 59 − 49 = 10, treating 59 as an exclusive end (as if Part 1 covered [0..59)), but begin=1 end=60 gives range_len = 60 − 1 + 1 = 60, so the 0-based exclusive end is 60, not 59.

The functional overlap-detection code is correct; only the comment is wrong. Fix: change '10 bytes' to '11 bytes' in the comment.
